items.reason: The subject head is the singular noun retreat, so the verb must be has, not have.
items.suggested_correction: The retreat of the continental ice sheets that once covered northern Europe has left behind thick deposits of gravel and clay.

items.reason: The plural subject humpback whales requires the plural possessive pronoun their, not its.
items.suggested_correction: During the coldest months, humpback whales migrate toward the tropics in order to raise their calves in warm coastal water.

items.reason: The quantifier should be most of the colonial merchants; the combination the most of is incorrect here.
items.suggested_correction: Even after the British Parliament imposed duties on imported goods, most of the colonial merchants continued to trade abroad.
